categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily as a global leading AI terminal hardware core supplier, focusing on intelligent manufacturing services and solutions. Its business covers AI smartphones and foldable phones, AI PCs and tablets, imaging displays, materials, battery power, thermal management (cooling), AI glasses and XR wearable devices, boutique assembly, sensors and related modules, and robotics. It also has significant operations in automotive and low-altitude economy sectors, as well as clean energy.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced manufacturing technologies including precision mold processing, stamping, CNC machining, injection molding, and automated assembly. It has developed intelligent AOI inspection systems, high-speed precision stamping, continuous stamping production lines, and unmanned green anodizing production lines. The firm integrates lean, digital, automated, and green manufacturing principles, and invests heavily in R&D for materials like carbon fiber, thermal management solutions such as vapor chambers, and robotics components including servo motors and reducers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global leading AI terminal product brands and their upstream suppliers, with deep collaborations with companies like AMD, Brembo, Huawei, Xiaomi, Lenovo, and BOE. The company serves consumer electronics, automotive (especially new energy vehicles), low-altitude economy sectors, and clean energy markets. It also supplies to overseas robot leaders and has a growing presence in North America and Europe.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with major manufacturing bases in China (Guangdong, Jiangsu, Sichuan, etc.) and overseas subsidiaries in the US, Europe (Finland, France), India, Brazil, Singapore, Vietnam, and Turkey. It has accelerated overseas base construction and local operations, aiming for a dual domestic and international business cycle.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream of the supply chain, providing core components, modules, and assembly services for AI terminal hardware. It extends upstream into materials and components like carbon fiber and battery structural parts, and downstream into boutique assembly and solution provision, positioning itself as a one-stop AI terminal hardware manufacturing platform.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include innovation leadership, international expansion, and vertical integration towards upstream materials and downstream solutions. R&D focuses on advanced materials (carbon fiber, ceramics), thermal management technologies (vapor chambers, heat pipes), robotics (servo drives, reducers, controllers), and AI wearable devices. The company emphasizes lean, digital, automated, and green manufacturing, and collaborates with universities and research institutes to cultivate technical talent.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of AI terminal hardware components, automotive parts, and clean energy products. The company also earns from ODM/OEM assembly services and solution provision. It operates mainly on direct sales with a small portion through distribution channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a global leader in AI terminal hardware manufacturing with a strong foothold in precision manufacturing and intelligent production. It competes with other high-end component suppliers in consumer electronics and automotive sectors. Its continuous innovation, comprehensive product portfolio, and global customer base provide competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 44.21 billion, a 29.56% year-on-year increase, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.753 billion. AI terminal business accounted for over 92% of revenue, growing 32.75%. The company maintains steady cash flow and has significant investments in R&D (about 4.47% of revenue). It has expanded its asset base and continues to grow through acquisitions and organic growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-precision, high-quality manufacturing with advanced technologies and integrated solutions, positioning itself as a one-stop AI terminal hardware platform. It differentiates through its comprehensive capabilities in materials, components, assembly, and intelligent manufacturing, enabling customized, scalable solutions. Its commitment to lean, digital, automated, and green manufacturing enhances efficiency and sustainability, while strong R&D and customer partnerships foster innovation and market responsiveness.
